webp-luk-17-36-36: Some Greek manuscripts add: “Two will be in the field: the one taken, and the other left.”
webp-act-8-37-37: TR adds Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” He answered, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”
webp-act-15-34-34: Some manuscripts add: But it seemed good to Silas to stay there.
webp-act-24-7-7: TR adds “but the commanding officer, Lysias, came by and with great violence took him out of our hands,”
webp-rom-16-25-25: TR places Romans 14:24-26 at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter 14, and numbers these verses 16:25-27.
